# Appendix C: Statistical model {#sec-app-model}

For repetition $i$, let $B_i$ and $C_i$ be the baseline and candidate measurements, $r_i$ the centered repetition position, and $o_i \in \{-1,+1\}$ the run-order contrast indicating which branch was run first. Let $m_i$ and $d_i$ be the midpoint and difference in measurements:

$$
m_i=\frac{B_i+C_i}{2},
\qquad
d_i=C_i-B_i.
$$

`foil` then fits two simple regressions:

$$
m_i
=
\mu+\mu_r r_i+\mu_o o_i+\varepsilon_i^{(m)},
$$

and

$$
d_i
=
\Delta+\Delta_r r_i+\Delta_o o_i+\varepsilon_i^{(d)}.
$$

`foil` uses the Bayesian bootstrap [@rubinBayesianBootstrap1981] to quantify uncertainty around the revision effect. `foil` also supports shrinkage, which acts only on the candidate-minus-baseline effect. The shrinkage parameter, $\lambda$, can be interpreted as the effective prior sample size for zero difference.
